message.content: No, Li Hua did not ask Wolfgang Schulz if he wanted to go to the gym together before Jennifer reminded Li Hua to participate in the gym's membership feedback activity. The conversation about Wolfgang Schulz admiring Li Hua's physique and suggesting a workout together happens after Jennifer reminds Li Hua about the gym's membership feedback activity. Specifically, it states, "WolfgangSchulz: Hey man! I honestly really admire that you have a good body shape! But all I can do is admiring you!" and "LiHua: That you are wrong, my friend! You should exercise more often, and I'm sure you will get a good figure in no time! WolfgangSchulz: Haha, you're making me blush. I know I need to hit the gym more! Maybe we can do a workout together sometime? That could be fun!" This exchange took place after the reminder about the membership feedback activity.
